landingFormalSummary: A trusted digital platform that helps young people in Rwanda access clear health information, practical tools, and verified care pathways.
landingHeadline: Nsobanuza supports young people with reliable health guidance, trusted learning tools, and safe access to care.
landingBody: Nsobanuza brings together health education, guided digital support, menstrual tracking, expert discovery, and youth-friendly resources in one place so that important questions can be answered with clarity, dignity, and confidence.
landingBriefBody: Nsobanuza is designed as a practical entry point for youth health support. It helps users learn, ask, track, and connect through one coordinated experience.
landingHighlightOneBody: The platform explains sexual health, mental health, relationships, and menstrual health in language that is easier to understand and act on.
landingHighlightTwoBody: Nsobanuza provides structured digital support through chat, educational content, and personal tracking tools that help users make informed decisions.
landingHighlightThreeBody: Users can move from information to action by identifying verified providers and preparing for consultations when additional support is needed.
landingPhotoOneAlt: Black woman using a mobile phone for digital health support
landingPhotoOneCaption: Digital guidance that meets young people where they already are.
landingPhotoTwoCaption: Health information should feel human, respectful, and approachable.
landingPhotoThreeAlt: Black female healthcare professional speaking with care
landingPhotoThreeCaption: Nsobanuza helps bridge trusted information and real human support.
landingServicesTitle: A brief and formal overview of the Nsobanuza offering
landingServicesBody: Each service is designed to support a different stage of the user journey, from awareness and learning to self-management and professional care.
landingServiceEducationBody: A structured feed of health posts helps users explore important topics and build practical understanding over time.
landingServiceChatBody: The AI assistant gives supportive answers to common health questions and helps users identify the next safe step.
landingServiceTrackingBody: Cycle logging and prediction tools help users monitor period history and prepare with more confidence.
landingServiceProvidersBody: Users can identify available health professionals and request support from trusted providers.
landingServiceVideosBody: Accessible video content supports users who prefer visual explanations and step-by-step learning.
landingServiceCommunityBody: Nsobanuza combines learning, guidance, and referral in one experience so users do not need to search across disconnected services.
landingJourneyTitle: A simple path from question to action
landingJourneyOneBody: Users begin with a concern, topic, or health need and access clear information without needing to know the medical system first.
landingJourneyTwoBody: The platform then provides tailored resources such as chat guidance, videos, or personal tracking to help users make sense of their situation.
landingJourneyThreeBody: When more help is needed, Nsobanuza helps users identify verified providers and prepare for the next step with confidence.
landingValuesBody: Nsobanuza is intended to be formal in purpose, friendly in experience, and practical in how it helps people move from uncertainty to informed action.
landingValuePrivacyBody: The experience is designed to reduce hesitation and make it easier for users to seek information about sensitive topics.
landingValueClarityBody: Information is presented in a direct and supportive way so that it can be understood by a broad youth audience.
landingValueTrustBody: Nsobanuza does not stop at content alone. It also supports pathways toward credible providers and responsible decision-making.
landingAudienceBody: The platform is relevant for young people seeking guidance, professionals who want to reach users responsibly, and partners who need a clearer digital channel for youth health engagement.
landingClosingTitle: A clearer, more supportive way to access youth health information and services
landingClosingBody: Whether someone is looking for answers, trying to understand a health issue, tracking their cycle, or preparing to speak with a professional, Nsobanuza provides a formal and approachable starting point.
